description.value: Sprout is a plant-based eatery in the heart of Nelson, BC, focused on creative vegan food served for dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The restaurant emphasizes fresh, accessible plant-based eating and also offers catering and online ordering. Nelson is a hub for cycling in the Kootenays, and Sprout makes a welcoming stop for cyclists seeking hearty, health-conscious meals.
